summary: Passage EVK50 (SC25 demo): 800 Gbps per fiber, 16-lambda BiDi NRZ 50G/lambda. 4.6 pJ/bit total wall-plug (2.6 pJ/bit photonics + Guide + ~2 pJ/bit XSR SerDes). BER < 10^-9, >1 km reach, polarisation-insensitive, 25–105 °C range.
Passage EVK100: 3.2 Tbps per fiber at 112G PAM4 (16 lambda). 1.9 pJ/bit (per ISES Korea 2025 efficiency table). Monolithic PIC: MRM modulators, TIAs, Tx drivers on single chip.
Passage L200: 32 Tbps optical I/O per chip (56G NRZ, 3D CoW, 320 SerDes). L200X: 64 Tbps at 112G PAM4. Both <5 pJ/bit. Bandwidth density >1.5 Tbps/mm. Targeted 2026.
Passage M1000: 114 Tbps total, 256 edge-attached fibers, 1024 SerDes lanes. 7735 mm² package, 34 chiplets, built-in solid-state OCS. Sampling summer 2025.
OCP CPO reference architecture initiative. Partners: Celestica, Corning, Dell, Flex, Foxconn, Hyve, Keysight, Qualcomm, Quanta. Standards: OIF, IEEE, OCP.
World-record 1.6 Tbps per fiber (Qualcomm 112G PAM4 SerDes + Passage L-Series). 8x more bandwidth per fiber than Near-Packaged Optics.
>60 % TCO savings and 3–7x training speedup for 4.7T-param MoE (256 experts, 8 active) over 576 XPUs using L-Series vs electrical. Roadmap: pluggables 17–20 pJ/bit → 3D CPO as low as 3 pJ/bit.
TPU v5p: 459 TFLOPS/chip, 95 GB HBM, 2.8 TBps HBM BW, 1200 GB/s bidirectional ICI per chip, 3D torus, 4x4x4 full cube.

Ironwood (2025): 4614 TFLOPS/chip, 192 GB HBM, 7.4 TBps HBM BW. 4x4x4 torus building block; 6 cube faces × 16 ICI links each. 96 optical + 80 copper + 64 PCB ICI connections per rack. Rack power-cap SLO < 15 ms; burst TDP window = 100 ms.
